items.title: What Will Bitcoin and Ethereum Be Worth in 5 Years?
items.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum have both slid hard from their highs, but analysts see wildly different futures for each. One faces a clear path back, while the other could end up a huge winner or a painful loser. Which one carries the bigger risk?

items.title: NYSE Affiliate to Launch 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading This Month
items.summary: Eligible U.S. customers will be able to trade tokenized versions of more than 70 assets starting on Nov. 23, said Intercontinental Exchange and OKX’s joint venture OKXICE.

items.title: OKXICE targets Nov. 23 launch for tokenized securities trading
items.summary:
Scott Melker breaks down OKXICE's planned November 23 launch of a tokenized securities trading platform under a proposed SEC innovation exemption. The platform has reportedly listed 70 tradable assets, including securities tied to BitGo (BTGO), Circle (CRCL), Coinbase (COIN), Robinhood (HOOD), Securitize (SECZ), and Strategy's STRC (STRC).

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Why the Tokenized Market Will Launch With a Heavy Focus on ETFs
items.summary: The exchange will launch mostly with exchange-traded funds after the vast majority of planned stock issuers objected to being included.

items.title: PNC Financial's Arm Broadens Digital Push With Stablecoin Payments
items.summary: PNC expands its COIN partnership with stablecoin payment services for corporate clients, aiming to speed up transactions and boost fee-income opportunities.

items.title: OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue Sets Launch, Turning to Crypto Companies After Big Tech Opts Out
items.summary: OKXICE will open its tokenized securities venue Nov. 23 with more than 70 assets, led by crypto companies like Coinbase, Circle, Robinhood and Strategy, after 67 companies objected to having their shares listed.
